features.title: SRE basic catalog (public-facing, no price, no CTA)
features.summary: Public-facing catalog extension of website_sale for SRE Commercial, built inside mechanic_workshop. Inherits website_sale.products_item (tile in /shop list + search results) and website_sale.product (detail page). Shows: name, image (if any), Brand (OCA product_brand), Manufacturer (public name only, never the brand's partner_id), MPN, SKU, public categories, demo description (clearly labeled illustrative-only).
